review_basis: Independent qualitative comparison of actual rendered first-version pixels; no author DESIGN/allocation rationale or other critic findings read before judgments.
scope: All 63 assigned pairs, involving themes 01–19. Theme 20 was seen only in the final contact sheets and has no B-assigned pair.

coverage.member: Full desktop and phone images viewed for composition at overview scale; native top/middle/bottom images viewed separately for all themes 01–19.
coverage.public: Full desktop and phone images viewed at overview scale; public desktop and phone top/middle/bottom checkpoint composites viewed for all themes 01–19. Desktop panels were reduced from 1440 to 720 px; phone panels were native 390 px.
coverage.contact_sheets: Initially viewed contact-desktop.jpg and contact-phone.jpg containing 01–13; later re-viewed their final versions containing 01–20.
coverage.capture_availability: All 80 full-page capture files existed at final inspection.
limitations: Full-page images are very tall and were displayed at overview scale; this is not a line-by-line native-resolution audit of every page region.
Native detail sampling is top/middle/bottom, not every intervening pixel.
Public desktop native 1440 px top/middle/bottom source crops were not separately opened; only their 720 px checkpoint panels were viewed.
No browser interaction, keyboard, hover/focus, opened roster/disclosure, source-link, data correctness or physical-device verification was performed.
Theme 20 has contact-sheet-only coverage and no individual-page judgment from reviewer B.
This is a visual pair comparison, not a preference ranking, statistical claim or formal approval.

bounded_readability_rework.observation: The far-right roster record wraps '1–0' and lets the 'Current' label meet the zero ('0Current'). The same form is visible in the public desktop checkpoint.
bounded_readability_rework.action: Give the W–L cell sufficient width and place its label on a separate line or block. Re-capture the directory at 1440 px.

bounded_readability_rework.observation: The large footer wordmark breaks inside GOAT and HOOPERS in its narrow left column.
bounded_readability_rework.action: Widen the brand column or control wrapping at word boundaries; preserve the large typographic footer.

bounded_readability_rework.observation: The two-digit club-register section marker appears as 0 above 6 in the narrow badge.
bounded_readability_rework.action: Keep the two-digit marker on one line by reserving badge width or using no-wrap; re-capture that phone heading.
